findings.finding: Although each local production start path quiesced before its own read, public database-status took neither the profile transaction lock nor state-aware runner quiescence. It could read concurrently during a runner or after a failed quiesce left a daemon runner alive.
findings.required_remediation: Make public database-status participate in the same transaction lock and, whenever durable state records production runner identities, quiesce those exact sealed runners before any DB read.
